steps.player: Hello!

steps.npc: Hello there, welcome to Varrock Museum! Can I help you?

steps.player: Tell me about the Museum.

steps.npc: Well, as you can see we have recently expanded a great deal to cope with the influx of finds from the Dig Site. Also, of course, to prepare for the new dig we're opening soon.

options.text: Tell me about the new dig.

steps.player: Tell me about the new dig.

steps.npc: Well, we recently had a large chunk of funds donated to us, so we sent out all sorts of explorers - I'm sure you'll meet them as you go around the world. People like Simon down in the desert near the pyramid as well

as Aristarchus in Pollnivneach, Varmen and, of course, Anna Jones. Anyway, we think we have discovered an island that has massive archaeological significance. We can't say much beyond that at this point, as we haven't
researched it. If you have the qualifications and help us out around the museum, I'm sure we could offer you a place on the dig when we're ready to go.

steps.player: That would be very nice.

options.text: I have some information which might be of use in your displays.
Tell me about other sections of the Museum.
I have some information which might be of use in your displays.

steps.player: I have some information that might be of use in your displays.

steps.npc: That's grand! We're always glad to have more facts. Now, tell me what you know...

steps.text: If the player has Demon Slayer completed:

steps.player: Well, I recently defeated Delrith, a demon! I did it by using a sword called Silverlight, which is apparently the only sword that could do it. I can give you a description if you want?

steps.npc: Delrith! Incredible! I am grateful to you for letting me know. Please tell me more about Silverlight and I'll get a display erected. Display number 25, 5th Age, year 20.

steps.text: If the player has Shield of Arrav completed:

steps.player: Well, I infiltrated one of the gangs here in Varrock...

steps.npc: We have gangs?

steps.player: Erm, yes...anyway, I managed to get half the shield back.

steps.npc: Only half?

steps.player: Yes. The gangs had a bit of a tiff, you see. A friend helped me get the other half and I returned it here to get my reward.

steps.npc: Yes, yes, we were most pleased to have the shield returned - as was the King, I imagine. This is wonderful news, I shall make sure the display is updated at once! Display number 24, 5th Age, year 700-800.
Oh, and before I forget, we found this old lamp lying around...and since you've done such a sterling job, we'd like you to have it.

steps.player: Oh, random bits of tat, thank you very much.

steps.npc: You're welcome!

steps.text: If the player has Rune Mysteries completed:

steps.player: I helped the Order of Wizards rediscover how to access the Rune Essence Mine.

steps.npc: Ah, I heard about that. Tell me more.

steps.player: Hmm. I can't tell you much, but I do know that this mine is hidden away. You can only get there by teleportation.

steps.npc: Sounds like magic to me! I'll get a display put up immediately. Display number 21, the first display of the 5th Age.

steps.text: If the player has Observatory Quest completed:

steps.player: I helped to rebuild the Observatory near Ardougne. I had to fight to do it, and learn how to use the telescope too. I can draw you a diagram of the Observatory if it would help.

steps.npc: That would help immensely. Restored it, eh? And it works, you say? Excellent, perhaps we can get to some real stargazing now! Display number 17, 5th Age, year 70.

steps.text: If the player has Merlin's Crystal completed:

steps.player: I helped to free the wizard, Merlin, by using Excalibur...

steps.npc: Is that some kind of spell?

steps.player: No, it's a sword. King Arthur's sword.

steps.npc: What kingdom does he rule then?

steps.player: Britain...

steps.npc: Where on Gielinor is that?

steps.player: It's not! That's what I've been trying to tell you. I found that King Arthur and his knights are really biding their time here in Gielinor until they are called back to their own world, when they are needed!

steps.npc: That's amazing! So he's really from another world! Well, this is interesting, I'll make sure a display is put up immediately. Well done, [player name]! Display number 9, 5th Age, year 132.
Oh, and before I forget, we found this old lamp lying around...and since you've done such a sterling job, we'd like you to have it.

steps.player: Oh, random bits of tat, thank you very much.

steps.npc: You're welcome!

steps.text: If the player has The Grand Tree completed:

steps.player: I helped to save the gnomes' Grand Tree!

steps.npc: Oh? You mean those little green fellows with their gliders?

steps.player: Yes. I uncovered this nasty character called Glough and ended up being ambushed by a black demon...

steps.npc: A black demon! How did you survive!?

steps.player: Oh, I was fine. After the demon it was downhill all the way, and King Narnode allowed me to use the mine under the Tree, and free passage on gnome gliders.

steps.npc: You mean that those flimsy things can fly with more than a gnome in? That is unexpected. I shall update the display immediately. Display number 10, upstairs in the middle of the room!

steps.text: If the player has Priest in Peril completed:

steps.player: Some disturbing and heroic news from Morytania, concerning the River Salve and the Temple Knights.

steps.npc: Ahh, the Temple Knights...little is known of them.

steps.player: Yes, it seems that these seven knights drove back the nasty things coming out of Morytania, and Saradomin blessed the Salve to stop them getting back.

steps.npc: Quite worrying that it's just a bit of water keeping them there, but Saradomin will protect us I've no doubt. Thank you for the information, I'll get a display put up. Display number 23, 4th Age, year 1100-1200.

steps.text: If the player has In Aid of the Myreque completed:

steps.player: Some disturbing and heroic news from Morytania concerning the River Salve and the seven priests.

steps.npc: Oh?

steps.player: Yes, it seems that these seven priests were also warriors and drove back the nasty things coming out of Morytania. Then Saradomin blessed the Salve to stop them getting back.

steps.npc: Quite worrying that it's just a bit of water keeping them there, but Saradomin will protect us, I've no doubt. Thank you for the information, I'll get a display put up. Display number 23, 4th Age, year 1100-1200.

steps.text: If the player has A Tail of Two Cats completed:

steps.player: You know Bob the Cat?

steps.npc: The little black cat that used to wander around sometimes? Sure, I remember him.

steps.player: I found out a lot about his background...turns out he was once human and helped to defeat a dragonkin once!

steps.npc: Dragonkin?
Tell me more!

steps.player: Well, you see, it started when Bob went missing...and involved a big sphinx in Sophanem, the City of the Dead, and me taking care of Unferth...

steps.npc: This is starting to sound familiar...

steps.player: It must...you know Reldo, the Varrock librarian - he knows all about Robert the Strong.

steps.npc: You mean that was Bob? Wow... I will get a display erected immediately about the history of this brave warrior. Display number 20, 4th Age, year 1-100.

steps.text: If the player has Making History completed:

steps.player: I found out more about King Lathas's ancestors.

steps.npc: Oh? I'd be interested to hear this, we have a painting of him upstairs.

steps.player: Indeed, it turns out that there was a big battle in the year 98 of the 5th Age. One of his ancestors became king because he survived it...

steps.npc: Ahh, is this relating to that small museum near Ardougne?

steps.player: Yes!

steps.npc: Ahh yes, we've been meaning to make a display on that for some time. They sent us some information, too; I'm glad you reminded me, I'll get that done now. Display number 46, 5th Age, year 98.

steps.text: If the player has Temple of Ikov completed:
If the player sided with the Guardians of Armadyl:

steps.player: Well, I was asked to retrieve the Staff of Armadyl, from the Temple of Ikov, by Lucien, but instead, I helped the guardians of the staff and banished Lucien from this plane of existence, so that he could never again return.
I saw the staff and can describe it to you if you want?

steps.text: If the player sided with Lucien:

steps.player: Well, I was asked to retrieve the Staff of Armadyl, from the Temple of Ikov, by Lucien. When I returned it he grew in power unimaginably. I held the staff and can describe it to you if you want?

steps.npc: Yes! Please do!

steps.text: You describe the staff in detail while the historian takes notes.

steps.npc: That's excellent, I'll get a display put up straight away! Display number 28, end of the 2nd Age.

steps.text: If the player has Curse of the Empty Lord completed:

steps.player: Well, I found out more about the Staff of Armadyl from a ghost. It seems that Zamorak was a mortal when he got hold of the staff, and he used it to, well...spear Zaros, and somehow ended up becoming a god. It was
a bit confusing.

steps.npc: Now that is what you call a story. Tell me more so that I can put it up on the display.

steps.text: You recount the tale of the battle between Zaros and Zamorak as you heard it from the ghostly swordsman.

steps.npc: This is wonderful, I shall have a display made immediately to go with the staff model. Display number 28, end of the 2nd Age.

steps.text: If the player has Hazeel Cult completed:

steps.player: I discovered the truth behind the Carnillean family fortune!

steps.npc: Oh? Is that the family over near Ardougne?

steps.player: Yes. I got a bit involved in family business...

steps.npc: And?

steps.player: I found a secret cult in Ardougne and found that the Carnillean family started building the city of Ardougne from a house they'd captured from a Zamorkian lord.

steps.npc: How exciting, I'll get a display put up immediately. Display number 7, 5th Age, year 7.

steps.text: If the player has What Lies Below completed:

steps.player: I discovered a tunnel and a cult of chaos mages here in Varrock!

steps.npc: Oh! Whatever can we do!

steps.player: Calm down, I have arrested the ringleader.

steps.npc: Oh, thank Saradomin for that. So, tell me the story!

steps.player: Well, I met Rat and he asked me to fill his folder, and I got mixed up with Surok....

steps.npc: A rat asked you to fill a folder?

steps.player: No, no, no - Rat Burgiss. But anyway, it turns out that this cult has been trying to get to the King, but I stopped them.

steps.text: If the player does not have the book Dagon'hai history in their inventory:
The historian looks a little overwhelmed, but also skeptical.

steps.npc: I don't suppose you have any evidence of this cult?

steps.player: Not with me, but there is a book I can get you from the library.

steps.npc: That sounds good - bring me that and we'll create a display.

steps.text: If the player has the book Dagon'hai history in their inventory:
The historian is scribbling furiously on his pad, and finally turns to you.

steps.player: Actually, to save you some writing, I have this book here that has lots of information. You can have it if you want...

steps.npc: Why, thank you... Yes, this is a bit of a revelation! I'll get a display put up immediately. Display number 3, 5th Age, year 70.

steps.text: If the player has Defender of Varrock completed:

steps.player: Well, we got rid of the marauding zombies.

steps.npc: That's handy. Zombies do tend to leave horrible muddy footprints around the place. So what actually happened with them?

steps.player: Well, Zemouregal the Mahjarrat sent his zombie army against Varrock. However, we figured out how to stop him.
I found out that the descendant of the founder of Varrock could use the shield to stop the zombie army. It turns out that Dimintheis was that descendant, so he was able to defeat the zombies.

steps.npc: My, my, that is all very interesting. I shall make sure the display is updated at once! Display number 24, 4th Age, year 700-800.
Oh, and before I forget, we found this old lamp lying around. Since you've done such a sterling job, we'd like you to have it.

steps.player: Oh, random bits of tat, thank you very much.

steps.npc: You're welcome!

steps.text: You receive an old lamp.
If the player has no new quests to report:

steps.player: On second thoughts, you seem to have everything I know covered here!

steps.npc: No matter. I'm sure you'll find more. Look around the Museum, explore the city and maybe do some quests, and I'm sure you'll find out something worth telling.

steps.player: Yes, I'll go do some quests or something...

options.text: Tell me about other sections of the Museum.

steps.player: Tell me about other sections of the Museum.

steps.npc: I'd be delighted to; which areas are you interested in?

steps.player: Tell me about the Natural History exhibit.

steps.npc: Ahh, our newest expansion. The Natural History exhibit in the basement was set up to inform our citizens of the weird and wonderful diversity in our environment today. Indeed, I am sure you will recognise some of
the creatures down there. Hopefully, our lectures will teach you some things you didn't know about them!

steps.player: So where does the 'history' bit come in?

steps.npc: Ahh, I see. The 'history' refers to that of the species - it doesn't necessarily mean it's died out. After all, we have human history and we're still here!

steps.player: I guess that makes sense.
Tell me about the Dig Site exhibit.

steps.npc: Ahh, those. We're slowly filling them up with the help of people who have their Earth Sciences exams completed at the Dig Site. If you have, feel free to give us a hand. We'd appreciate it.

steps.player: Tell me about the Dig Site find cleaning area.

steps.npc: The cleaning area, yes. Well, we have some really good archaeologists on site right now. They're cleaning up the finds that are shipped over from the Dig Site to the east of here. If you have the right qualifications, you can help them clean the finds.

steps.player: What qualifications?

steps.npc: Level 3 Earth Science exams. You can take them over at the Exam Centre on the Dig Site.

steps.text: If the player has not passed the exams:

steps.player: Oh, I don't have those.

steps.npc: I'm sure you can get them easily enough. Just pop over to the Exam Centre on the Dig Site and speak to one of the examiners there.

steps.text: If the player has not yet taken the exams during The Dig Site quest:

steps.player: Oh, I'm already working towards those!

steps.npc: That's excellent. Keep up the good work and soon you'll be cleaning finds with the best of them.

steps.text: If the player has passed the exams:

steps.player: Oh, I already have those!

steps.npc: That's excellent. If you feel like helping us out, pop downstairs and clean up some finds for us.

steps.player: Tell me about the Timeline exhibit.

steps.npc: Ahh, my speciality. Being a historian, matters of the past are my passion. Collated on this floor and the one above are just part of my life's work. I am still working on updating and finding out more everyday, so if you find
any information on your travels that may be useful, please do let me know.
You can follow the timeline of the history of Gielinor from the creation of the world to the present day, simply by walking around this display. A wondrous journey, I think you'll agree!

steps.player: Wow, that's a lot of information. I'm sure in my travels and quests I'll pick up a few bits of information for you.
